newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Wills says unaware why price rose.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Wills says unaware why price rose.

text.p: Australian tobacco group W.D & H.O Wills Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that it knew of no reason for a recent rise in its share price.
Wills was replying to an Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) query. The ASX said it had noted a recent fluctuation in the price of Wills shares to A$2.50 on Thursday from A$2.07 on January 2.
Wills told the ASX it was not aware of any matter of importance about to be be announced nor was it aware of any information concerning the company that might explain the rise if generally known.
Wills shares were trading at a new 12-month high of A$2.55, up 15 cents, at 0200 GMT (1.00 p.m.) on Thursday on volume of 55,143 shares.
